notes: Planner slides: click any text box and the size menu in the toolbar changes that box: the title, the text, the bottom line and the rest. Biggest that fits picks the size for you.
The box you click gets a frame: drag its bar to move it or a handle to resize it, and Put back returns it to the layout. The .pptx keeps the new places and sizes.
+ Add slide adds a title and text slide straight away; the arrow beside it opens every layout. Timetable can set a different usual slide.

Words are never cut off: text that runs past its box stays visible in the editor with a warning, and when you present the box uses the room under it, then the text gets smaller until every word shows.
